statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on all OCI DB systems in scope
statements.query: MATCH (n:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Mark DB systems as exposed if a DB node VNIC has a public IP and one of its subnet's OWN security lists admits non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (same test as the instance job)
statements.query: MATCH (sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (sys)-[:HAS_DB_NODE]->(:OCIDbNode)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH DISTINCT sys SET sys.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress' IN coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sys END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress'

statements.__comment: Mark DB systems as exposed if a DB node VNIC has a public IP and one of the NSGs attached to THAT VNIC admits non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
statements.query: MATCH (sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (sys)-[:HAS_DB_NODE]->(:OCIDbNode)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH DISTINCT sys SET sys.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress' IN coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sys END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a DB node VNIC with a public IP whose subnet, subnet security lists or NSGs are not in the graph cannot be proven closed, so the DB system is exposed
statements.query: MATCH (sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (sys)-[:HAS_DB_NODE]->(:OCIDbNode)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) WITH sys, vnic, subnet, count(DISTINCT sl) AS known_security_lists OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) WITH sys, vnic, subnet, known_security_lists, count(DISTINCT nsg) AS known_nsgs WHERE subnet IS NULL OR known_security_lists < size(coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, [])) OR known_nsgs < size(coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, [])) WITH DISTINCT sys SET sys.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_ip_unresolved_rules' IN coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sys END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_ip_unresolved_rules'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a DB node whose VNIC is not in the graph (GetVnic failed) may have a public IP, unless the DB system's subnet is known to prohibit public IPs, so the DB system is exposed
statements.query: MATCH (sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (sys)-[:HAS_DB_NODE]->(dn:OCIDbNode) WHERE NOT (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(:OCIVnic) OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: sys.subnet_id}) WITH sys, subnet WHERE coalesce(subnet.prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic, false) = false WITH DISTINCT sys SET sys.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'db_node_vnic_unresolved' IN coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN sys END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(sys.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'db_node_vnic_unresolved'

statements.__comment: Build publicContext JSON for exposed DB systems from their DB nodes' public VNICs and the open rules that apply to them
statements.query: MATCH (sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE sys.exposed_internet = true OPTIONAL MATCH (sys)-[:HAS_DB_NODE]->(dn:OCIDbNode)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH sys, dn, vnic, collect(DISTINCT sl.id) AS openSecurityListIds OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH sys, dn, vnic, openSecurityListIds, [r IN collect(DISTINCT {nsgId: nsg.id, ruleId: rule.id, protocol: rule.protocol, source: rule.source, tcpPortMin: rule.tcp_dest_port_min, tcpPortMax: rule.tcp_dest_port_max}) WHERE r.ruleId IS NOT NULL] AS nsgRules WITH sys, [v IN collect({dbNodeId: dn.id, hostname: dn.hostname, vnicId: vnic.id, publicIp: vnic.public_ip, privateIp: vnic.private_ip, subnetId: vnic.subnet_id, openSecurityListIds: openSecurityListIds, nsgRules: nsgRules}) WHERE v.vnicId IS NOT NULL] AS publicVnics SET sys.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: sys.id, resourceType: 'oci-database-dbsystem-instance', context: [{dbSystemId: sys.id, displayName: sys.display_name, hostname: sys.hostname, subnetId: sys.subnet_id, exposureTypes: sys.exposed_internet_type, publicVnics: publicVnics, region: sys.region}]}])
